Finish with 5 min slow breathing: in through the nose 4 s, out 6 s. Keep sipping water until bed. Skip the walk if you feel dizzy, have a headache or are very tired; do the mobility and breathing only.

sessions.title: Shake-out run 20 min
sessions.details: Purpose: build aerobic endurance and impact tolerance. Warm-up: 5 min brisk walk, then leg swings 10 per leg each way, walking lunges 8 per leg, ankle rocks 10 per side, 2 × 20 m easy skipping. Main: 15 min very easy run-walk (RPE 2–3) plus 4 × 15 s relaxed strides. Legs should feel springy, not tired. Keep it short even if you feel great. Cool-down: 5 min easy walk, then calf stretch 45 s per leg, standing quad stretch 45 s per leg, hamstring stretch 45 s per leg, figure-four glute stretch 45 s per side. Total about 20 min. If unusually tired, sore, dizzy or you slept under 6 hours: do the same time as brisk walking only, or swap for 20–30 min walking. Pain that changes your stride: stop and walk home. Start before 06:30. Carry water. On hot, humid mornings, slow down rather than speed up.

sessions.title: Rest + travel to Moshi
sessions.details: Day before the race: rest. 10–15 min easy walk to loosen up. Collect your race number. Carbohydrate-rich, low-fibre meals (section 15). Lay out kit, set two alarms, bed by 21:00.

sessions.title: RACE — Kilimanjaro Half Marathon 21.1 km
sessions.details: Race day: start 07:00 at MoCU Gate, Sokoine Road, Moshi; cut-off 12:30. Follow the race plan in section 15: breakfast at about 04:00, start slower than feels right, walk the steep parts of the 8 km climb, carbohydrate every 20–25 min, drink to thirst at every water point. Enjoy it.
